title: 49ers use Seattle's three turnovers to take 21-13 halftime lead

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers use Seattle's three turnovers to take 21-13 halftime lead
sources.description: The 49ers forced three turnovers, leading to two short touchdown drives and a defensive score, and they sacked Sam Darnold four times in the first half.
